text.es: Me duele que otra persona vea tu sonrisa de enamorada, que pueda coger tu mano caliente en el bolsillo de un abrigo, que quieras alargar las noches con otra persona para que no llegue el amanecer. Que imagines un futuro con alguien que no soy yo. Porque siempre pensé que yo era única para ti.
text.en: It hurts me that someone else sees your smile when you're in love, that someone else can hold your warm hand in a coat pocket, that you'd want to make the nights longer with someone else so that dawn never comes. That you'd imagine a future with someone else who isn't me. Because I always thought I was the only one for you.
